question: Show the details of rooms including the full name of the rooms, the building names, floor numbers, the organizations occupying them, name of the departments occupying them, and the percentage of the room area over the assignable floor area and building.
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE rooms AS
SELECT 
  fclt_room_key,
  fclt_building_key,
  room_full_name,
  room,
  floor,
  organization_name,
  minor_organization,
  CAST(dept_code AS VARCHAR) AS dept_code,
  area
FROM beaver."FCLT_ROOMS"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE floors AS
SELECT 
  fclt_building_key,
  floor,
  assignable_area
FROM beaver."FCLT_FLOOR"

  assignable_area
FROM beaver."FCLT_BUILDING"

  room_full_name,
  room,
  floor,
  organization_name,
  minor_organization,
  CAST(dept_code AS VARCHAR) AS dept_code,
  area,
  ['fclt_room_key','fclt_building_key','room_full_name','room','floor','organization_name','minor_organization','dept_code','area'] AS columns
FROM beaver."fclt_rooms"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "floors" AS SELECT 
  fclt_building_key,
  floor,
  assignable_area,
  ['fclt_building_key','floor','assignable_area'] AS columns
FROM beaver."fclt_floor"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "buildings" AS SELECT 
  fclt_building_key,
  building_name_long,
  assignable_area,
  ['fclt_building_key','building_name_long','assignable_area'] AS columns
FROM beaver."fclt_building"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH rooms AS (
  SELECT fclt_room_key, fclt_building_key, room_full_name, room, floor, organization_name, minor_organization, dept_code, area
  FROM rooms
),
fl AS (
  SELECT fclt_building_key, floor, assignable_area AS floor_assignable_area
  FROM floors
),
bld AS (
  SELECT fclt_building_key, building_name_long, assignable_area AS bldg_assignable_area
  FROM buildings
)
SELECT 
  r.room_full_name AS room_full_name,
  b.building_name_long AS building_name,
  r.floor AS floor_number,
  r.organization_name AS organization_name,
  r.minor_organization AS department_name,
  r.area AS room_area_sqft,
  CASE WHEN fl.floor_assignable_area IS NULL OR fl.floor_assignable_area=0 THEN NULL ELSE r.area / fl.floor_assignable_area END AS pct_room_of_floor_assignable,
  CASE WHEN b.bldg_assignable_area IS NULL OR b.bldg_assignable_area=0 THEN NULL ELSE r.area / b.bldg_assignable_area END AS pct_room_of_building_assignable
FROM rooms r
LEFT JOIN fl fl
  ON r.fclt_building_key = fl.fclt_building_key AND r.floor = fl.floor
LEFT JOIN bld b
  ON r.fclt_building_key = b.fclt_building_key
WHERE r.access_level IS NULL OR 1=1
LIMIT 200
